We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "I want to change one team member's role from full agent to read-only observer, but I'm concerned that changing the role will disconnect them from tickets they were previously assigned to — does the assignment history survive a role conversion?" The policy excerpts include DOC-033 parts 1-3 about changing seat role. Part 2 says: "Assignment history is attached to the person's account, not to their current role, so records previously assigned to someone moving to observer remain assigned to them and remain visible in that history; an observer role only changes what the person can do going forward, specifically that new work cannot be assigned to them and they cannot take actions requiring an agent or admin role."

Thus answer: Yes, assignment history remains; it stays attached to the account, visible, role change only affects future assignments. Also role change can be done via Settings → People without removing, and takes effect on save, no need to sign out. Provide concise answer.

We must post_reply.
